Our Story

A Meal That Feels Like Home

Amrut Aahar serves wholesome, traditionally cooked meals on a banana leaf — the way food was meant to be shared. Every plate is prepared fresh each day, following age‑old recipes that bring comfort with every bite.

From a fragrant sambar to a slow‑cooked leafy‑greens dal, our kitchen keeps the flavours of home alive for everyone who walks through our doors.

“అరిటాకు భోజనం అనగానే అమ్మ ప్రేమ, పండగ వాతావరణం, పాత స్నేహాలు కళ్ళ ముందు మెదుల్తాయి”
"The moment you say banana‑leaf meal — a mother's love, a festive spirit, and old friendships come alive before your eyes."
